ExpireLoginToken.description_en: Invalidates a Wuying Workspace logon session before it naturally expires
ExpireLoginToken.description_zh: 在无影登录态自然失效之前，人工将其置为失效

GetAuthCode.description_en: Retrieves an authorization code that contains user identity and permission information, which can be used to invoke cloud applications in integration scenarios
GetAuthCode.description_zh: 获取一个包含用户身份信息和权限信息的授权码，在集成场景中可使用该授权码唤起云应用

GetStsToken.description_en: Retrieves a Wuying STS token (temporary identity credential)
GetStsToken.description_zh: 获取无影STS Token（临时身份凭证）
